summary: ProfilePress live writes must preserve auditable apply outcomes, readable multi-line diffs, and safe position-level Experience edits through the user-controlled browser session.
reason: LinkedIn live profile writes are sequential and can partially succeed, so failures after any successful section need a local audit log entry; Experience descriptions require the edit form rather than whole-section SDUI guessing, and multi-line profile sections need line-prefixed diffs to remain reviewable.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passed for profilepress; a Chrome-session LinkedIn snapshot verified the requested Experience text was updated without network notification.
